description: Browse the skills for one jurisdiction or domain (for example every skill for 'MT', or every 'payroll' skill), each with its current approval label. Fact-check history is separate from professional approval. For a specific topic, search_skills is quicker. Filter by jurisdiction, domain or role ('foundation' | 'compute' | 'orchestrator' | 'reference'). Paginated (default 100, max 200); page with offset/next_offset.

domain.description: Filter by accounting domain: income-tax, vat-gst, payroll, bookkeeping, e-invoicing, formation, financial-reporting (also matches financial-statements), audit-assurance, practice-management, advisory, transfer-pricing, tax-optimization, crypto, cross-border, corporate-tax, estate-wealth-tax, references, sector-guidance, tooling.

offset.description: Number of skills to skip — use the next_offset from the previous response to page through results (default 0).

role.description: Filter by pipeline role: foundation, compute, orchestrator, reference.

name: list_skills

limit.description: Page size applied to this response.

next_offset.description: Present when more results remain — pass as offset to fetch the next page.

approval.description: Current public professional approval. Use label verbatim; source/fact checks do not grant approval.

label.description: Approved by [name], or Not yet approved.

tier.description: 1 = current public accountant approval, 2 = Not yet approved. Independent source checks are separate.

verification.description: Recorded fact-check counts and dates only, not professional approval. Use approval.label for the skill's approval status.

total.description: Total skills matching the filter (across all pages).

title: Browse tax skills
